rationale: Resuming growth after turn 2 stasis. Lactate and glucose are abundant primary carbons; arginine and cysteine provide nitrogen and sulfur. Mixed-acid fermentation produces acetate, butyrate, formate, and CO₂. Carbon audit: 10×3 (lactate) + 6×6 (glucose) + 5×6 (arginine) + 2×3 (cysteine) = 97 mmol C in; growth at 0.30/h costs 30 mmol C + 9 mmol net C in products (6.5 + 5.5 + 2.0 + 8.0 − recycled) = 47 mmol C out; balance feasible. Nitrogen: 3 (NH₄) + 5 (Arg) + 2 (Cys) = 10 mmol N in; growth costs 8 mmol N; adequate.
